text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the request of the friendly local greengrocer,
Haru Urara became the team leader for the shopping district's tug-of-war contest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm the tug-of-war team leader!
Yay, that's so, so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, an Umamusume serves as the leader
for every single team—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, everyone! Let's all work together as a team and do our best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The winners are our teaaam!!
Burning fireee!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's pumped up!
Alright, I'm gonna give it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chaaan!
Good luuuuck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the direction of the voice was a large banner reading "Urara Cheering Squad," alongside a crowd of fans waving to her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Look, look, Trainer!
It says "Urara Cheer Squad"! That's so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
I'm definitely, definitely going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the spirited response, the cheer squad erupts into a roar of excitement.
Before long, the tug-of-war competition kicked off, but—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, Team Haru Urara... was a bit more underwhelming than I hoped."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I-It's still totally fine!
...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's team was on a losing streak...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! So frustrating!
I felt like I was thiiis close to winning the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"What should I do?
Hey, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: If we win, let's go get some carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right!
After all, I'm the leader...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Alright... *ahem*!
Everyone on the team! Listen up closely!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Losing over and over really stings, doesn't it!
I can totally feel how frustrated everyone is!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, you can't give up!
Because you're super, duper strong!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We were so close earlier!
If we sync our breathing, we'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the cheerful, energetic cheers, the shopping street was enveloped in applause and shouting.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Team Haru Urara, let's go-o-o!
Ei-ei-oh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The team's atmosphere improved dramatically,
leading them to a glorious victory in the next battle.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Carrot cake!? Really!?
Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, if you win,
you get to eat carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So let's do our best, everyone!
Pull the rope on 'Carrot!' 'Cake!' okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so enthusiastic about "Carrot cake!"
gradually softened her teammates' expressions—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Ready, begin!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Carrot, in!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text: Cake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: CARROOOOOOOT!!!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: CAAAAKE!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next battle, thanks to "Operation: Carrot Cake,"
she achieved a glorious victory!
